objectDescription: Demo users of the Demo Factory: the accounts Playwright signs in as in the target applications (a demo picks one in settings.demoUser). One row per user — id, label, the application it is meant for. The user's API key is never in this payload: save-demo-user writes it to the secret store (organization level, demo-factory-user-<id>), and DemoFactoryDemoUserEvents fills `configured` on every read.
